description: A general-purpose many-to-many mapping connecting DPWH District Engineering Offices (DEOs) to Philippine legislative districts (LEGs) for reuse across projects, tools and dashboards. Contains no monetary amounts; those live in evidence/source_amounts.json. Does NOT assign projects, allocate budgets, or establish legislative representation.
breakingChangesFrom_1_0_0: Primary source is now the COMPLETE 264-row allocation table, not BetterGov's 108-row multi-link subset. Coverage rises from 108 to 264 rows.
District node ids are keyed on the canonical official-roster jurisdiction (e.g. leg:cotabato:1st, not leg:north-cotabato:1st), so some ids changed.
Offices gained a 'region' field from the table's Region column.
Legacy registry-only offices are now flagged with a 'legacy' block instead of being silently emitted as unlinked offices.
Representative lookups now surface ambiguity explicitly rather than picking one.

metadata.completeness: Covers every row of the source allocation table (264 rows, 200 offices, 254 distinct districts). Missing DEO-district pairs do NOT imply absence of a real-world relationship; they only mean the table did not record one.
metadata.relationshipMeaning: Each relationship records that the source allocation table linked an office to a legislative district. It does NOT prove geographic boundaries, project ownership, legislative sponsorship, or current validity.

manyToManyEvidence.note: The mapping is genuinely many-to-many. Examples of districts served by more than one office: Manila 6th (North + South Manila DEO), Mountain Province Lone (1st + 2nd DEO), Basilan Lone (BARMM + Isabela City DEO). Examples of offices spanning several districts: Bulacan 1st DEO (1st, 2nd, 5th), Cavite 1st DEO (1st, 3rd, 6th, 7th).

allocationTable.underlyingDocument: DPWH per district.pdf -- 9-page scanned allocation schedule (PCIJ-sourced; fiscal year NOT stated in the document)
allocationTable.extractionNote: Independently transcribed from the scan. Validated against BetterGov's separate 108-row transcription: all 106 numeric rows reproduce exactly (see validate_sources.py). A third, independent local OCR pass disagreed on 8 amounts; every disagreement traced to a leading-digit OCR error in the local pass (1 misread as 4), confirming this extraction.

betterGovSubset.note: BetterGov transcribed only the multi-link subset of the same scan (29.8% of its total allocation value). Used here solely to corroborate the primary extraction, never as a mapping source.

projectCodeRegistry.note: Official DPWH project-code to DEO-name mapping (19 regions). Vintage predates several office splits and contains no BARMM entries. Matched to the allocation table by accent-insensitive EXACT name only; substring matching was rejected because it produced false positives (e.g. 'South Cotabato 1st DEO' -> 'Cotabato 1st DEO'). Legacy names are flagged, never used to create relationships.

representativeRoster.extractionNote: Rebuilt by build_official_roster.py from the directory's STRUCTURED MEMBER TABLE ('| Name | District | Seat |', repeated 3x in the dump), which is authoritative for (name, kind, seat). Leadership roles are taken from the prose headings and one table name suffix. Two earlier extractions parsed the prose for seats and were both wrong: v1 dropped seats carrying a leadership-role prefix (losing Isabela 6th); v2 searched a fixed character window ahead of each heading, so the one heading with no seat line of its own borrowed the NEXT member's seat and fabricated a second representative for Southern Leyte 1st. Both defects are gone and asserted against in the builder.
knownRosterDefects: congress.gov.ph mislabels Iloilo province 2nd district as 'Iloilo City, 2nd District' (Kathryn Joyce Gorriceta). Iloilo City is a lone district, so a 2nd Iloilo City seat cannot exist. Corrected here; see ROSTER_SEAT_CORRECTIONS in join_districts.py.

Two seats list two representatives each (Antipolo City 2nd: Acop, Philip Conrad 'Dok Bong' M. / Acop, Romeo M.; Cavite 4th: Austria-Barzaga, Jennifer / Barzaga, Francisco 'Kiko' A.). Left unresolved rather than guessed, and both candidates' profiles are attached for each.

A third seat appeared ambiguous only because of the v2 prose-parser defect described above. Southern Leyte 1st has a single representative, Mercado, Roger Gaviola. The name previously attached to it, Mendoza, Raymond Democrito C., is a TUCP party-list member holding no district.

Counts are internal to this scrape and not reconciled against any stated House total: the dump itself declares no member count. 324 distinct people = 256 district entries spanning 254 unique seats + 68 party-list.

legislativeProfiles.joinNote: Adds member_code, detail_url and a locally scraped portrait per representative. Joined on the exact (seat, name) pair with whitespace normalised -- never on name alone, because the same name can appear on a party-list seat and a district seat. Ambiguous seats receive one profile per candidate rather than a single chosen rep. Party-list members are present in the scrape but are out of scope for this district crosswalk.

statutoryReferences.effect: Renamed Compostela Valley to Davao de Oro
Created Davao Occidental from Davao del Sur

warnings: The underlying scan states NO fiscal year. Amounts must not be assumed to be FY2027 or any other year.
Allocation rows do not establish project attribution or sponsorship.
BARMM appears as an office-like label but is a regional grouping, not a single engineering office.
Legacy registry offices carry project codes but zero districts by design.

65 rows show a DEO ordinal differing from the district ordinal (e.g. Pangasinan 4th DEO serves PANGASINAN (THIRD DISTRICT)). This is genuine in the source, not an error, but means office numbers cannot be used to infer districts.

rosterSeatCorrectionsApplied: congress.gov.ph lists this seat as 'Iloilo City, 2nd District'; corrected -- see ROSTER_SEAT_CORRECTIONS in join_districts.py

legacy.note: Registry holds a single undivided Cavite office; the table shows three.
Legacy 'Sub DEO' designation; no counterpart in the allocation table.
Compostela Valley was renamed Davao de Oro (RA 11297, 2019) and the table shows two successor offices. Which one inherits the old code is unverified.
Cotabato City is a BARMM city and appears nowhere in the allocation table. NOT the same as the North Cotabato (Region XII) offices -- do not conflate.
Davao Occidental was carved out of Davao del Sur (RA 10360); the table shows one consolidated Davao del Sur DEO plus a separate Davao Occidental DEO.
Singular/plural spelling variant of the same office.
'Mt.' abbreviation plus a pre-split single office; the table shows two.
Table names the first office 'Sorsogon DEO' and numbers only the second ('Sorsogon 2nd DEO'). Inferred equivalent; treat as provisional.
Undivided legacy office; the table shows two successors.
Undivided legacy office; the table shows two successors. NOT related to the Leyte 1st-5th DEOs.
Table names the first office 'Tarlac DEO' and numbers only the second ('Tarlac 2nd DEO'). Inferred equivalent; treat as provisional.
Undivided legacy office; the table shows two successors.
